responsibility: Implements a compact index-based directed graph representation for pre-existing node indices, storing successor slices in contiguous arrays and optionally storing mirrored predecessor slices as back-references for efficient generic graph-trait access.
same_name_distinction: Among the `mod.rs` files, this one is the compact index-based graph representation built from preexisting node indices and contiguous successor slices; unlike `graph/implementation` it is not payload-rich mutable storage, and unlike `graph/iterate` or `graph/scc` it is representation rather than analysis.
